source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: With the probe, a burst with a lost block and no D_PDU error moves MAX-SPEED down one position of the bulk walk.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-errored-burst-moves-one-bulk-rung: bulk_rungs [0, 1, 3], probe_run 3. Flow as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or that PADDING and a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (h = 1, e = 1: 1000 per thousand, over the 500 limit, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; bulk thresholds on WN 4 Long -100, 0, 100, 150, on WN 7 Long -100, -50, 100, 400; latency on WN 2 Long -100, 100, 200, 400, on WN 4 Long -100, 100, 300, 400, on WN 7 Long -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. Here the burst at 200 has two blocks (bytes_received at 230 and 240): 16 bytes with no sync that are not all zero (the D_PDUs in it lost their headers), then a PADDING, as drc-rx-lost-block-not-clean: h = 0, e = 0, no cap, but the first block is a lost block (corpus-format.md 6.2). P7-9 round 4 (corpus 0.37.0, interp C-1291 as ruled 2026-11-09): with the probe on, the estimate moves MAX-SPEED down only after a burst whose D_PDU error rate is over rx_error_limit_ppt (e x 1000 > rx_error_limit_ppt x h) or which has a lost block, and then to max(T, down(R - 1)), one position of the walk at most; the caps still apply after. At 100 a clean burst on WN 7 Long, estimate 450: MAX-SPEED WN 7 Long (position 3), LOW-SPEED WN 6 Long (position 2). At 200 the burst on WN 7 Long, estimate -700: S = -125; the bulk target is 0 and the lost block is a trigger, so MAX-SPEED moves to max(0, down(2)) = 1, WN 4 Long (down(2) skips position 2, off the walk); no cap, so no ceiling. LOW-SPEED moves down at once to 0, WN 2 Long. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 100: bulk target 1 equals MAX-SPEED, and the probe needs 3 clean bursts on WN 4 Long (it has 1): MAX-SPEED holds at WN 4 Long; LOW-SPEED holds at WN 2 Long as in drc-rx-errored-burst-moves-one-bulk-rung. EOWs: 0x8A4, 0x9A2, 0xB04, then 0x8A4, 0x9A2, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all; with the error rate alone as the trigger, 0x8A7.
